pages.title: Warrior Houses
pages.text: Small $(thing)warrior houses$() are scattered across the Overworld. When you get close to one for the first time, a mercenary is waiting there to be hired.$(br2)Every mercenary belongs to one of the classes: $(l:epicvanguard:classes/berserker)Berserker$(), $(l:epicvanguard:classes/guardian)Guardian$() or $(l:epicvanguard:classes/duelist)Duelist$().

pages.title: Prisoners of War
pages.text: Next to $(thing)Pillager Outposts$() you may find a wooden cage holding a $(thing)prisoner$(): weak, unarmed and wounded.$(br2)Rescue them for free: see $(l:epicvanguard:getting_started/recruiting)Hiring a Companion$().

pages.title: Calling a Company
pages.text: You can also build a $(l:epicvanguard:vanguard_point/vanguard_point)Vanguard Point$() at your base and pay to have a new mercenary march to you.
